messages:
ryan_sales: Quick heads-up — Sunburst (healthcare analytics) is asking for a bespoke sliding-scale discount. They want 40% off hosted API usage for the first 12 months, then 25% year 2. Committed spend is $120k ARR, plus they want Private deployment + SOC2 attestation. POC next week. Can we approve, or what counter?

devon_dealdesk: 40% is pretty deep. What's our margin at that commit level if they move to Private later? Also need to know whether Reserved/Dedicated is involved or just hosted with a private plane.

ryan_sales: They're starting hosted but want the option to upgrade to Private/Dedicated in Q3 if POC looks good. So initial purchase = hosted; later add-on could be dedicated. They expect a single contract with add-on pricing.

micah_eng: From an infra POV, Private/Dedicated ramp costs are significant. If they convert, we should require a 60-day notice and a migration fee to cover infra reconfiguration. Estimating ~$12k one-time ops cost. Also, if they keep sustained high seq lengths for embeddings+generation, token spend will be higher than typical — need to flag that to pricing.

anya_re: Security ask: they want SOC2 + an on-site audit window and KMS integration (customer-managed keys). Private deployment adds complexity on the contract side. Legal will want language around data residency and a clearly scoped security addendum.

devon_dealdesk: OK. Two quick asks for approval flow: 1) provide a simple margin calc (ARR vs estimated cost) 2) confirm migration fee + contract language. If margin < 30% we need VP signoff.

ryan_sales: Margin calc (high-level) — commit $120k ARR; expected hosted unit cost estimate after discounts ~ $60k/yr; gross margin ~50% before migration fee. If we add migration fee $12k first year margin drops ~41%. Numbers are rough.

micah_eng: Can you paste the assumptions? sequence length, tokens/month? I'll validate infra cost.

ryan_sales: Sure — assumptions I used: 8B model variant, avg sequence length 1k tokens, 200k generated tokens/mo -> ~2.4M tokens/yr; embedding calls ~1.2M units/yr. Used conservative unit-cost = $0.02 per 1k gen tokens equivalent after quantization & batching.

micah_eng: That unit cost feels optimistic for Private conversion. But for hosted POC it's OK. If they convert to Dedicated GPUs, ops + committed hardware shifts cost basis. We should build a conversion pricing delta clause.

devon_dealdesk: Proposal to present to Sunburst: - Initial hosted special: 30% off list for 12 months (instead of 40%), with a <$12k migration credit if they commit to Dedicated within 9 months. - If conversion happens, apply a predefined conversion schedule (price uplift to baseline private rate with 30-day notice). - Require a signed security addendum for KMS/SOC2.

ryan_sales: Sunburst already pushed hard for 40% citing competitive offer. If we counter with 30% + migration credit that might land. Need quick approval on the migration credit and conversion schedule.

anya_re: Legal is fine with the migration credit construct, but we need to ensure the addendum includes: data residency, KMS responsibilities, audit scope, and breach notification SLA. That will add ~2-3 weeks to contracting timeline.

ops-bot: @devon_dealdesk please confirm if finance needs to route this as a special discount (manual override). Ticket #SD-4721 created.

devon_dealdesk: Finance — yes, manual override required. Also marking this as escalated: VP approval required if final discount >35% or margin <30%.

ryan_sales: Ok — I’ll present the 30% + migration credit counter to Sunburst POC today and flag the security timeline. If they insist on 40% we’ll escalate.

micah_eng: TL;DR: approve 30% hosted for 12mo + $12k migration credit contingent on contract language for conversion costs. Ops will need a runbook for migration.

devon_dealdesk: I'll draft the pricing amendment and conversion schedule. Ping me if they accept 30% and we can route for VP signoff. :thumbsup:
